Relax SDHMS replaces Samsung’s normal thermal policy with a less restrictive fallback. This removes software CPU/GPU limits and model-specific overheat controls, and can affect charging and other heat controls.

The phone may become dangerously hot, cause skin burns, shorten battery life, or damage hardware. External cooling does not guarantee safe internal temperatures. Kernel protections remain separate and do not guarantee safety.

This choice stays enabled after reboot. Stop using the phone if it becomes hot and turn this option off to restore Samsung’s normal policy. SDHMS will restart briefly; the phone will not reboot.
